entries.name: Colombian Independence Day
entries.capsule: July 20 marks the 1810 revolt in Bogotá that began Colombia's path to independence; a national holiday in Colombia.
entries.dateRule: July 20 every year (fixed; not moved to Monday).

entries.whatItMarks: The July 20, 1810 revolt in Bogotá (the Florero de Llorente episode) that began Colombia's independence process.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: A Minnesota mother told MPR News she first saw the Colombian dance group now called Colombia Live at a Colombian Independence Day celebration in 2010. No 2025 or 2026 Minnesota event announcement was found.

entries.name: Día de las Velitas
entries.capsule: On the evening of Dec. 7, families light candles and lanterns to open the Colombian Christmas season.
entries.dateRule: December 7 (eve of the Immaculate Conception, Dec. 8); not a public holiday.

entries.whatItMarks: A Catholic tradition of praying on the nine days before Christmas, usually at home with family and neighbors, with villancicos and buñuelos.

entries.whatItMarks: The birth of Jesus; in Colombia the season runs from Dec. 7 through Christmas and into the new year.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Colombia Live staged a sold-out Christmas-season family show, La Cucharita, at the Wellstone Center in St. Paul on Dec. 9, 2023; former Sen. Patricia Torres Ray said the community had lacked such a show. A Worthington resident described home celebrations with Colombian foods in 2014.

entries.name: Epiphany (Día de los Reyes Magos)
entries.capsule: The Magi's visit, Jan. 6; Colombia's public holiday moves to the following Monday.
entries.dateRule: Feast on January 6; under Colombian law the public holiday is observed on the Monday on or after Jan. 6. Dates below are the Colombian public holiday.

entries.name: Independence of Cartagena
entries.capsule: Commemorates Cartagena's independence from Spain; Colombia observes the public holiday on a Monday in mid-November.
entries.dateRule: A Monday public holiday in November (Nov. 16 in 2026 per Calendario Colombia). The 2027 and 2028 dates are projected using the Monday on or after Nov. 11 and are not confirmed by an opened page.
